questions.q: How do Intel and Qualcomm each describe their reliance on TSMC?

quotes: We have no long-term contract with TSMC, and if we are unable to secure and maintain sufficient capacity on favorable pricing terms

Microsoft says the potential replacement of the rescinded rule, along with other AI rulemakings, could adversely affect its business.
quotes: The IFR would have imposed a worldwide licensing requirement on our data center products, such as our H200, GB200 and GB300.
The potential replacement of the rescinded AI Diffusion Rule, expanded export license conditions, and other potential AI-related rulemakings

may lead to power safety shut offs due to wildfire risk, which can have adverse implications for our Santa Clara, California headquarter offices and data centers
